column1: # Ash Jenna's automatic post-Manticore confrontation. No recruitment choice.

column3: You made it through.\nI thought you might.{end_wait}
You followed us here.\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}
So you survived.\nI wanted to see\nwhat you'd do next.{end_wait}
You have Jenna's face.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I have her face.
But I'm not the girl
you remember.{page_break}Tell me, Isaac.
Have you ever wondered
why the Wise One chose you?{end_wait}
We chose to come.\nIsaac didn't make us.{end_wait}

You follow his orders
without knowing why.
What did he tell you?{page_break}Did he tell you what
would happen if you
failed to stop the beacons?{end_wait}
We're trying to stop\nwhat happened at Vale\nfrom happening again.{end_wait}
You haven't told us\nwhat you want.\nWhy are you here?{end_wait}
You stayed with that\nminer when he was afraid.\nI remember that, Isaac.{end_wait}
I wanted to see\nif you'd hesitate\nwhen you saw me.{end_wait}
Have you seen Jenna?\nIs she safe?{end_wait}

You still think I'd
give you that answer?
How sweet.{page_break}I could tell you
anything, Isaac.
You'd want it to be true.{end_wait}
That's enough.\nShe's playing with us.{end_wait}
Then walk away.\nI won't stop you.\nNot today.{end_wait}
Stay away from\nmy friends.{end_wait}
When you reach the\nnext beacon, Isaac,\nthink about what I said.{end_wait}
We need to reach Kalay.\nThere's no point in\narguing with her.{end_wait}
Jenna is still out there.\nWe can find her.{end_wait}
Go on. Find her.{page_break}When you finally\nreach Jenna, remember\nwho let you leave.{end_wait}
